slides.0.title: Course Introduction
slides.0.content: Top Sweet Wines — Quarts-de-Chaume & Bonnezeaux — This course covers Quarts-de-Chaume and Bonnezeaux, exploring the geography, soils, varieties, and style characteristics of these prestigious AOCs.
slides.1.title: Top Sweet Wines — Quarts-de-Chaume & Bonnezeaux
slides.1.content:
This course provides a systematic study of the terroir of Quarts-de-Chaume and Bonnezeaux, helping you build a solid knowledge framework for the Loire Valley.

Through systematic learning, you will be able to identify the typical styles of these AOCs and accurately describe their characteristics during tasting.
slides.2.title: Quiz
slides.2.questions.0.question: Which of the following AOCs is covered in this course?
slides.2.questions.0.explanation: Quarts-de-Chaume is an important AOC in the Loire Valley and the core subject of this course. It is Loire's only Grand Cru AOC, recognized in 2011.
